mapper.select: SELECT ic.code, ic.name, ic.unit, curr.value AS value, prev.value AS prev_value, curr.observation_date AS observation_date FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation curr ON ic.id = curr.indicator_id AND curr.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(o1.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation o1 WHERE o1.indicator_id = ic.id ) LEFT JOIN indicator_observation prev ON ic.id = prev.indicator_id AND prev.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(o2.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation o2 WHERE o2.indicator_id = ic.id AND o2.observation_date < curr.observation_date ) WHERE ic.code IN ('US05Y', 'US10Y', 'US30Y', 'US10Y_US05Y_SPREAD', 'US30Y_US10Y_SPREAD') ORDER BY ic.id

SELECT io.observation_date, io.value, ic.code FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code IN ('US05Y', 'US10Y', 'US30Y') ORDER BY io.observation_date, ic.code

SELECT io.observation_date, io.value, ic.code FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code IN ('US10Y_US05Y_SPREAD', 'US30Y_US10Y_SPREAD') ORDER BY io.observation_date, ic.code

SELECT ic.code, ic.name, io.value, io.observation_date FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code IN ('US3M', 'US1Y', 'US02Y', 'US05Y', 'US10Y', 'US30Y') AND io.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(io2.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation io2 WHERE io2.indicator_id = ic.id ) ORDER BY ic.id
